targets: Separate original reported bases: MUSA retail; Casey reported fuel excluding card fees including RIN; ATD US company-operated before payment fees
scope: Completed-period pre-earnings nowcast only. Baseline proxy available after period end; no completed-period market inputs used for an earlier in-quarter forecast
event_clock: Group all releases by available_at date; next-day date-only information cutoff. Releases with available_at strictly before cutoff are eligible; recipient reporting at cutoff is still treated as pre-report (no same-day actuals)
peer_selection: Latest already published positive-overlap fiscal period per donor; donor end must predate cutoff; preserve source hashes and target overlap days
transfer_input: Donor actual minus its earlier-trained own-basis forecast, multiplied by target-calendar overlap fraction; calendar fraction is exposure proxy not observed gallons
loading: Recipient-donor through-origin ridge with penalty10 in raw cpg units; bound loading to [0,1]; minimum8 earlier published recipient residuals and eligible pre-report donor matches within same start-date regime
training: Earlier recipient periods must end before current recipient starts; recipient outcomes published before current cutoff; historical donor selection uses earlier recipient report-date cutoff, never its later hindsight report
update: Baseline plus half the average of eligible donor loading times overlap-weighted surprise; recompute from baseline, never add the same event cumulatively
no_effect_rule: No overlap or insufficient training means unchanged forecast with explicit reason; an earnings release is not forced to affect every company
evaluation: Score one final checkpoint per recipient target, compare baseline on identical targets. Report all targets with blocked unchanged states and separately eligible shadows; event diagnostics paired before/after not independent quarterly samples
regimes: Period start before2020, 2020 transition, 2021 onward; no blind pooling
governance: No fitted shared latent model, no absolute margin averaging, no post-result parameter tuning, no automatic promotion or live schedule deployment
